evidence.reason: The parser requires exactly one HEAD line for every record from `git worktree list --porcelain -z`. Git emits the main record of a bare repository with `worktree <path>` and `bare` but no HEAD, so cleanup rejects the registry before it can reach the owned linked worktree. The configured `clone` accepts any non-empty string and no bare-repository rejection is present. This is a parser correctness bug for valid Git output; accepting the bare main record does not relax the HEAD/branch checks for the owned worktree.
